What is a cube?

A cube is a three-dimensional shape that has 6 square faces, 8 vertices and 12 edges of equal length

What is the volume of a cube?

Unit Cube

Unit cube is a cube whose sides are 1 unit long

The volume of a cube is the space occupied by it. It is also the total number of unit cubes that the cube can accomodate.

Volume of a Cube Formula

Derivation

If we stack square sheets of side length ‘s’ one over the other, a cube is formed.

Volume of the cube = (Area of the base) x Height

= (Area of the square sheet) x (Height)

Rectangular Prism vs. Cube

If the length, width, and height of a rectangular prism are equal, it forms a cube

Volume of a rectangular prism = l x w x h cubic units

For l = w = h = s,

Volume of a cube = s3 cubic units
